kind-induction-on-the-weft.signal: stage-8 kind induction (induceKinds/falsifyKinds) run against a weft pass, or a request to certify an induced kind
kind-induction-on-the-weft.read: kinds are induced from COMPANY (co-presence), never taught; the gold (UD PROPN) is injected to judge only — no POS, no capital, no word list enters the inducer. The induced partition MUST beat the frequency band AND clear the shuffled-company null (which permutes whole company vectors across referents: marginals survive, structure does not). MEASURED (khora treebank-seeded pass over ud-english-pud test, 1000 sentences, real UD PROPN gold, 2026-10-07): with the cast carried, the kinds are meaningful (countries grouped; months grouped; NMI(induced, PROPN)=0.171) but the DECLARED separation (weighted std of gold rate across kinds) is granularity-sensitive — singleton kinds inflate BOTH the induced and the null, so at n~60 referents the induced cleared the null's p95 (0.293 vs 0.262) only after excluding singletons and did NOT clear p95+SESOI(0.05). Report as a failure; do not move the SESOI after a run. Next lever: a separation not dominated by kind size (size-matched random partition; NMI/ARI against a size-matched control).
kind-induction-on-the-weft.falsifying: a certification that moves the SESOI after the run; an induced kind equal to a frequency-band partition; or a separation a size-matched random partition also achieves — any breaks the rule
kind-induction-on-the-weft.basis: swarm 2026-10-07: janus/KIND-INDUCTION-REPLY.md, kind-induction.js (induceKinds/frequencyBands/shuffledCompanyNull/goldSeparation/falsifyKinds), the treebank-seeded first run

the-readers-nomos.signal: a claim about the reader's growing priors, what carries across books, the for-whom as accumulation, or reading a corpus in order with accumulated expectations
the-readers-nomos.read: the reader's FOR-WHOM is the accumulation of expectations of how IDENTITIES and KINDS normally behave, sedimented in publication order; janus canonicalizes those expectations into NOMOS (janus/native/organs/nomos.js — 'the ledger of the rules of reading'), which feeds back as the priors khora reads by. CAST DOES NOT CARRY (a referent is the fold at a point, per book; earlier individuals never join a later book's cast); BEHAVIOR DOES (a growing prior over how kinds behave, canonicalized into nomos). Surprise is the ground so far (surprise-segments.js, Rubin: 'the ground was most wrong') plus the delta to the holograph (bayes-surprise.js, Itti & Baldi). The chronologic key is khora/native/eval/weft/chronology.mjs (a derived year from each doc's own front matter — a signal that may be wrong; a year-unknown doc is a TYPED gap, never defaulted to now). Recorded whole in 3.0/the-readers-nomos.md.
the-readers-nomos.falsifying: a nomos row that is REVEALED (no giver, no builder) — refused by licenseNomos; a CROSS-BOOK CAST LEAK (an earlier book's individual entering a later book's cast); or an expectation that does not move the reader's surprise at all (a nomos the reader does not read by) — any breaks the rule
the-readers-nomos.basis: breakthrough 2026-10-07: the chronological corpus read with a growing kind-prior; grounded in khora/native/kernel/{for-whom,surprise-segments,bayes-surprise}.js, janus/native/organs/nomos.js, khora/native/eval/weft/chronology.mjs

the-canonical-cycle.signal: a question about the reader's cycle, what makes it fully activated/canonical, or the loop read -> surprise -> expectations -> nomos -> priors -> read
the-canonical-cycle.read: the cycle is the NINE operators applied to the log, not a new N-step process: NUL (open the void) -> SIG (the difference) -> INS (admit the being; cast, per book) -> SEG (segment in publication time + cut where the ground was most wrong) -> (FLD∨HNT∨MTH, mouth-last) -> CON (link: how the KIND behaves, P(relation|kind)) -> DEF (the nomos row: standing/giver/binding/address) -> EVA (corroborate against the null) -> REC (record + feed the next void), with SYN the seal realizing the licensed rule into a prior khora reads by. Closing edge REC ↬ NUL = agentic. LAWS: cast does NOT carry (a referent is the fold at a point, per book) but behavior does; a rule is GIVEN or EXTRACTED, never REVEALED; no self-confirmation (a candidate is a law only when a null licenses it); the loop is the log's projection (re-key without erasing, P3; replay P159); an expectation the reader does not read by is decorative. ACTIVATION (2026-10-07): active = NUL/SIG/INS/DEF(static priors); built-but-inert = EVA (fold-at imports bayes-surprise.predict but reports wired:false), SEG (surprise organs exist, no read path calls them); missing = CON's behavior object, REC's derived-prior overlay in loadPriors, SYN, and the chronological ordered read (builder reads sharded). The minimal activation closes the loop on one book: read book1 -> surprise -> extract ONE kind-behavior expectation -> write it a derived-prior CANDIDATE (builder+source+witnesses) -> nomos row -> corroborate on book2 vs the null -> license -> SYN -> loadPriors reads it -> read book2 with it and show the surprise shift. Recorded whole in 3.0/the-canonical-cycle.md.
the-canonical-cycle.falsifying: a CROSS-BOOK CAST LEAK (an earlier book's individual in a later book's cast); a REVEALED nomos row (no giver, no builder) not refused by licenseNomos; a candidate licensed without a null; a rule stored beside the weft rather than folded from it; or a licensed nomos whose presence does not move the next read's surprise — any breaks the rule

priors-have-one-home-janus.signal: a reading prior (pos/frame/role-config/morph-cues/morphology/case-marking/code/notation/lang) is loaded, mirrored, or placed anywhere other than janus/priors; or a question about where the priors live
priors-have-one-home-janus.read: the rules of reading are Relate's, so EVERY prior has ONE home at <root>/janus/priors (2026-10-08; moved from khora/native/priors + Zenodotus/derived-priors/case-priors, incl. all code/notation priors). khora reads them as DATA (a path, never a module import — janus imports khora one-way, so no cycle); data-gated: an absent prior leaves the reader bare (a typed gap, never a guess); every prior names its giver and nomos folds it (licenseNomos refuses REVEALED). Consumers that still read khora/native/priors must re-point or they read a stale copy = drift. Verified: reader-bundle.js::loadPriors resolves janus/priors (grammarPrior true from there). See janus/priors/README.md.
priors-have-one-home-janus.falsifying: a prior loaded from anywhere other than janus/priors (a copy in khora is drift); a loadPriors that silently falls back to a local copy instead of a typed bare read; or a nomos row for a REVEALED (no-giver, no-builder) prior not refused by licenseNomos — any breaks the rule
